key_findings: In ligature-induced periodontitis mice, Aa EVs reach the brain and induce TNF-α and IL-6 via TLR4/TLR8-MyD88 signaling.
Aa EVs are retrogradely transported to trigeminal ganglion neurons and increase nociceptor excitability.
